name: Return capsule

parts.name: body
parts.massBasis: Large ~4.9 m return capsule body with 7 material layers (ablative heat shield, structural shell, insulation, internal framing). Hollow construction with heavy heat shield at base lowers CoM. Variance below 1/12 reflects mass concentrated in outer shell and base rather than uniform fill.
